Services

Property management with a long-term perspective.

Support for accidental landlords, busy investors, out-of-state owners, and portfolio investors.

A plan built around your property

Start with what you own, what it needs, and what you want it to achieve. Rankin Property Management brings tenant placement, rent collection, maintenance coordination, reporting, owner communication, and investor support into one relationship.

The details, connected

A leasing decision affects future property care. A repair affects expenses and the resident experience. Clear reporting helps you understand the bigger picture. The goal is to keep those decisions connected rather than treating them as isolated tasks.

Know the scope before you start

Your written proposal and management agreement define the services, fees, responsibilities, and approval process. Discuss any existing residents, deferred maintenance, insurance considerations, and transition needs before onboarding.
